他居然在？！夏晚安盯着韩经年错愕了几秒，才收回视线，往窗外看了一眼。车子停的地方，离周围的路灯有些远，车内光线相对较暗，他还穿了一身黑色的西装，若不是电脑发出的光亮，还真是挺难让人发现后车座上坐了一个人，不过……他这个日理万机的大忙人，大可派张特助跑一趟就好了，何必屈尊亲自跑一趟？从她上车后，韩经年自始至终都没太大的反应，就仿佛她是个空气一般，可他身上无形散发出来的压迫，让夏晚安明显的感觉车内的空气变得有些稀薄。她不安的往车门的方向挪了挪，把自己和他之间的距离稍微拉开了一些。也不知道是不是她的动作，惊扰了他，她感觉到他的头往她这边偏了一下。他很细微的举动，让夏晚安条件反射的看向了他。他和她只是对视了一眼，她就惊的目光四处乱飞。他很安静，俨然是没什么要开口的意思，可她却有点纠结了……她要不要打个招呼呀？可她打招呼的话，该说点什么？又该怎么称呼他？老公肯定是喊不出口的，韩经年太过于直呼其名，韩总韩先生又显得她很矫情……夏晚安考虑了一会儿，最后用了个“那个”代替了他的称呼：“那个……原来你在车上呀？”去买水的张特助，打开门就听到了这句话，险些噗嗤的笑出声来。那个……哪个？夫人还真可爱，居然叫韩总那个……韩经年没接话。夏晚安略带着几分尴尬的摸了摸鼻子，垂头去看手机了。将这一幕尽收眼底的张特助，忍不住在心底重重的叹了一口气。他不喜欢吃瓜，但他喜欢吃韩总的瓜……他还以为他擅作主张的将夫人请上车后，能看点好戏，哪知……好戏没有，他还得替韩总收拾烂摊子……想着，张特助就开口，缓和气氛了：“夫人，喝点水吧。”“谢谢。”夏晚安投给张特助一个感谢的眼神，接了水。“夫人，您打架没伤到哪里吧？”“没。”“夫人，您为什么打架呀？”“……”夏晚安和张特助聊了没几句，张特助的手机响了。张特助说了句“抱歉”戴上耳机去接电话了。夏晚安透过后视镜，偷偷地看了一眼还在盯着电脑屏幕看的韩经年，然后就低头去看刚刚一直在手心里震动个不停的手机了。宋有蔓建了个新的微信群，群名叫“拔吊无情的小白脸”，里面就三个人，她，韩知谨和宋有蔓。（宋有蔓）：“我到家了，请问你们都还好吗？”（韩知谨）发了一张照片，是墙壁，后面补了句：“面壁思过g……”

He's actually here? ! Xia Wan'an stared at Han Jingnian in shock for a few seconds before looking away and looking out the window. The car was parked a little far away from the surrounding street lights. The light inside the car was relatively dark. He was also wearing a black suit. If it weren't for the light emitted by the computer, it would be difficult for anyone to notice that there was a person sitting in the back seat. But...he was a busy man with many things to do. He could just send Zhang Te to help him, so why deign to do it himself? After she got into the car, Han Jingnian didn't react much from beginning to end, as if she were air. However, the invisible pressure emanating from him made Xia Wan'an feel that the air in the car had become a little thin. She moved uneasily towards the car door, slightly increasing the distance between herself and him. She didn't know if her movements disturbed him, but she felt his head tilt towards her. His subtle move made Xia Wan'an look at him reflexively. He and she just looked at each other, and her eyes flew around in shock. He was very quiet, as if he had no intention of speaking, but she was a little confused... Should she say hello? But what should she say to say hello? What should I call him? My husband definitely couldn't shout out. Han Jingnian called her by his first name too much, and Mr. Han, Mr. Han, seemed to be pretentious... Xia Wan'an thought about it for a while, and finally replaced his title with "that": "Um... So you were in the car?" Zhang Teshu, who was going to buy water, heard this sentence when he opened the door and almost laughed out loud. That...which one? Madam is so cute, she actually called Mr. Han... Han Jingnian didn't answer. Xia Wanan An touched his nose with a bit of embarrassment and lowered his head to look at his phone. After seeing this scene in full view, Special Assistant Zhang couldn't help but sigh heavily in his heart. He doesn't like to eat melons, but he likes to eat Mr. Han's melons... He thought he would be able to watch some good shows after he took the initiative to invite his wife in the car, but who knows... If there is no good show, he has to clean up the mess for Mr. Han... Thinking about it, Special Assistant Zhang spoke up and eased the atmosphere: "Madam, drink some water." "Thank you." Xia Wan'an gave Assistant Zhang a thankful look and took the water. "Madam, you didn't get hurt anywhere in the fight, did you?" "No." "Madam, why did you fight?" "..." After Xia Wan'an chatted with Special Assistant Zhang for a few words, Assistant Assistant Zhang's cell phone rang. Assistant Zhang said "Sorry" and put on his earphones to answer the phone. Through the rearview mirror, Xia Wan'an secretly glanced at Han Jingnian, who was still staring at the computer screen, and then lowered his head to look at the cell phone that had been vibrating in his hand just now. Song Youman created a new WeChat group called "The ruthless pretty boy". There were only three people in it, her, Han Zhijin and Song Youman. (Song Youman): "I'm home. Are you all okay?" (Han Zhijin) sent a photo of a wall, followed by the sentence: "Facing the wall and thinking about it..."
